title: Provision — shared VTA reservation definitions
description: Shared types for the provision/vta/* family: a Farm reserves a VTA behind a trigger link, a wallet claims it with a fresh key, and the claimant redeems the hand-over once the person has confirmed the claim check. Defined once so claim and redeem describe the same handle. The family rules are in CONVENTIONS.md beside this file. Not itself a Trust Task specification (the `_shared` folder is skipped by the registry build and the codegen).

Handle.title: Handle
Handle.description: The Farm-generated handle of one reservation: 16 to 32 bytes from a cryptographically secure random source, written as unpadded base64url (22 to 43 characters; 16 bytes, 22 characters, is what VTI-LNK-116 recommends). It is the `_id` of the trigger link (VTI-LNK-033) and is compared as a string. In a claim it MUST equal the document's `parentThreadId`. It confers no authority on its holder beyond the right to make one claim.
